summary: A single VivaCity camera at King St / Pitt St, Sydney (9 zones, 18 directions). It had a camera-wide outage from 24 Apr to 16 Jul 2025 that the automatic fixes only partly caught, and a mid-afternoon step change in detection on 2 Oct 2024 that raised every zone, so each direction is split into a series before and after the change. After the change, the Pitt St Mall footpath (340) and the King St bike path west of Pitt (343, especially from Dec 2024 to mid-Feb 2025) show recurring bursts of false detections, which are set missing.
